title: US quarterly equity expiration (September 2027 triple witching) — two sessions after the FOMC decision, undisplaced
source: OCC: THE PUBLISHER'S OWN 2027 EXPIRATION CALENDAR, reached and read in-session 2026-09-06 on a domain that answers where theocc.com does not. The Options Industry Council's expiration calendar at optionseducation.org — a site whose every page footer reads verbatim "(c)2026 The Options Clearing Corporation. All rights reserved." and whose footer logo links to theocc.com, i.e. OCC's own publication, not a third party — serves the 2027 edition in two artifacts, both fetched here: (1) its backing JSON at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), whose legend maps GUID 6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B to "Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading" and whose data array carries that type on 2027-09-17 exactly; and (2) the linked print edition, 2027-Expiration-Calendar.pdf (HTTP 200, 98,956 bytes), whose single 1169x1077 page image was inflated and rendered in-session, showing September 2027's grid marked 13 (LEAPS added), 15 (volatility products), 16 (A.M.-settled index options cease trading), 17 (the monthly equity/index expiration) and 30 (quarter-end quarterly expiration). The same API reproduces all twelve 2026 expirations, including every date the five confirmed opex-2026-* entries in this calendar already carry (08-21, 09-18, 10-16, 11-20, 12-18) and the Juneteenth-displaced 2026-06-18 Thursday, 12 of 12 — the source validates against this repo's own confirmed rows before being trusted with a new one. Independently reproduced by arithmetic: 2027-09-03, -10 and -17 are September 2027's first three Fridays, and the same calendar's 2027 holiday set (01-01, 01-18, 02-15, 03-26, 05-31, 06-18, 07-05, 09-06, 11-25, 12-24) puts no closure in expiry week, so the third Friday is undisplaced. PROMOTED from the estimate this event was proposed at, on the precedent the construction-spending-2026-12-01, new-home-sales-2026-11-25, fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24/-2026-12-29/-2027-01-26/-2027-02-23 lanes set: the no-self-confirm convention binds the sweep that DISCOVERED an event (here fomc-2027-09-15), not its independent second look, and OCC: is this taxonomy's named confirmed prefix for an options-expiration calendar. The PDF carries the disclaimer "accurate as of 12/18/2025" and the API edition "accurate as of 1/2/2026"; both name 2027-09-17. Assessed 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-2027-09-15 initial research (2026-09-06); this is its independent initial research, which promoted the date to confirmed and raised the tier. IMPACT FILED high, NOT low as proposed, to follow the class convention rather than the class outlier: the five confirmed opex-2026-* entries run quarterly=high (09-18, 12-18) / monthly=medium (08-21, 10-16, 11-20), and opex-2027-03-19 is high. Only opex-2027-06-17 is a quarterly filed low, which its own ledger flagged in writing as "the calendar's own outlier" and left for one alignment pass. Copying the outlier would have made two quarterlies wrong instead of one. The cost is stated rather than hidden: high halves the pulse interval (14 days against 30), so this event's staleness ceiling forces roughly twice as many full sessions. THE TRAP, and it is why this note exists: fomc-2027-03-17 built a "treat the decision and the expiry as one event window" corridor rule on the +2 shape (decision two sessions before the third Friday); fomc-2027-06-09 withdrew it only as "not this meeting's shape" at +6, leaving it to reinstate itself the moment a +2 meeting appeared; fomc-2027-09-15 refused to reinstate it on decision-day RETURNS (permutation P=0.163). This lane tested the volume side and the naive answer is a loud YES — quarterly witchings at gap +2 mean 2.147 relvol against 1.862 otherwise, permutation P=0.002 — but 92% of that cohort is dated 2013+ against 20% of the rest, because +2 IS a modern FOMC scheduling arrangement, and witching volume grew structurally over the same span. Era-ranked the effect is P=0.326; inside 2013+ alone the sign REVERSES (-0.08, P=0.537). The corridor rule is dead on both halves. scripts/research/fomc-expiration-proximity.mjs prints all three controls together so nobody rediscovers the raw number alone. A SEPARATE VOCABULARY TRAP: OCC's calendar legend uses "Quarterly expiration date" for the QUARTER-END expiring series (2027-03-31, 06-30, 09-30, 12-31), not for triple witching — a session grepping that source for "quarterly" would date this event 13 days late. No house playbook is opex- or calendar-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped 2026-09-06, one hit, the word "triples" in an unrelated sentence). Confirmed status widens nothing here: research is not action, symbols is empty, and nothing in the house system keys on an expiration.
